title: Random independent sets and local sparsity
summary: We analyze random constructions of independent sets in locally sparse graphs, specifically graphs with bounded maximum average degree in neighborhoods or with fractionally $r$-colorable neighborhoods. Specializing our methods to finding large independent sets and low-weight fractional colorings, we focus on optimizing for marginals, but we also derive results that find many independent sets (i.e.\ give lower bounds on the independence polynomial) by optimizing for entropy.
